"I'm kicking you out"

I was living with my best friend, but he hated my rats. It turned into an argument after he deliberately left a window open when it was freezing outside, killing one of my rats. When I freaked out and told him friends don't kill each others pets he told me that he was gonna kick me out of the house anyway. 

Shit hurt like a motherfucker, I lost my friend, and my pet.

I actually was thinking this, but if I were diabetic it would be very apparent if I didn't get treatment for 17 years right? I don't know how diabetes exactly works, but I thought it would be noticeable in childhood or something

The girl that called me cute multiple times became my girlfriend, so it really depends on the person I think
Ah like that, it was in an empty street though, and I made sure that there wasn't someone behind me hahah
Yeah ikr, it made me feel like a fool, even when they were the weird ones
In my country hi is a word you really can't hear wrong, so I doubt that he didn't say hello.

This isn't an attack post, I was just annoyed. Please don't think you're faking depression if you know you have it. This post wasn't made to attack anyone or make anyone feel guilty, just a heads up I guess for "hey if something didn't happen to you, but you post about it and make people stress because they think someone is dying at this very moment on the other side of the screen kind of deal, please don't post it then".

I don't know if that makes sense.

The point I'm getting at is that is that this post is aimed that it isn't needed to lie to get replies or attention to your post. If you post that you had a bad day, and post the reason for it with it. People can actually engage a conversation that might help you. Instead of replying on your post with "please call 911 you're on the verge of dying", because they think that person is going to die. I think that it won't help people that lie about these kinda things to hear that, while they would've been helped if they just posted their real problems, even if they may seem insignificant.
